name: ns_crossing
doc: numeric_state below:30 fires only when the value crosses from >=30 to <30.

name: ns_threshold_equality
doc: 30 is not below 30; 30 re-arms; 29.99 fires.

name: ns_already_below_at_startup
doc: Value already below at homeassistant_started: not armed, so no fire until it rises >=30 and drops again.

name: ns_unavailable_recovery
doc: below -> unavailable -> below fires (unavailable arms); same for unknown.

name: ns_unknown_at_startup
doc: unknown at homeassistant_started arms the trigger; the first numeric value below fires.

name: ns_missing_at_startup
doc: Entity has no state at attach: warning, not armed; first value below does NOT fire.

name: ns_non_numeric
doc: A non-numeric state logs a warning and leaves the armed flag unchanged: 40 (armed) -> abc -> 25 fires; 25 -> abc -> 24 does not; 40 -> abc -> 20 fires.

name: ns_attribute_only
doc: Attribute-only writes neither fire nor arm/disarm.

name: ns_condition_motion_off
doc: became_dark fires while motion is off: the automation's state condition fails; no run.

name: st_to_on
doc: state to:on fires on any change whose new state is on (from anything, incl. unavailable).

name: st_on_at_startup
doc: Motion already on at homeassistant_started: no trigger.

name: st_created_on
doc: Entity created directly as on (old_state None) fires.

name: st_change_during_startup
doc: States written after setup but before homeassistant_started are missed.

name: same_tick_batch
doc: Real 2026-11-04 21:54:57: hue writes motion=on and lux=22 in one batch. Trigger dispatch is deferred (call_soon), so the motion trigger's conditions already see lux=22: both triggers run (the second restarts). Written 1 ms apart instead, the motion trigger's conditions see lux=45 and fail.

name: wait_basic
doc: on -> lights on; off for 5 min -> lights off. wait.remaining is None (no timeout).

name: wait_reenter_restart
doc: off, then on again after 4 min with conditions passing: restart; new 5 min from the next off.

name: wait_reenter_conditions_fail
doc: on re-enters while lux >= 30: conditions fail so no restart; the old wait's for-timer resets on the next off.

name: wait_attribute_only
doc: Attribute-only motion write during the 5 min does not reset it.

name: wait_unavailable_blip
doc: off -> unavailable -> off restarts the 5 min.

name: wait_already_off
doc: Motion goes off while light.turn_on is still running (3 s latency): wait_for_trigger subscribes afterwards, so the off is missed.

name: wait_wall_jump
doc: A wall-clock jump of +1 h during the 5 min does not shorten it (loop time).

name: mode_restart_order
doc: Restart: conditions are checked first; then 'Restarting', the old run is stopped, then automation_triggered.

name: mode_single_drop
doc: single: a second trigger while running is dropped with a WARNING 'Already running'; no event, last_triggered unchanged.

name: time_day
doc: A full GMT day: 23:00/06:30/09:30 brightness bands (light on), 23:30 kitchen off, 10:00 kitchen check.

name: time_light_off
doc: Hallway light off: the 23:00 trigger runs but its state condition fails.

name: time_condition_edges
doc: choose time windows at their edges (after inclusive, before exclusive, across midnight).

name: kitchen_condition_edges
doc: Kitchen: sun below at 09:59:59 (time condition false), 10:00 time trigger fires, below at 23:29:59 true, 23:30:00 false.

name: dst_autumn
doc: Europe/London 2026-10-25 02:00 BST -> 01:00 GMT: time triggers at local wall times both days; motion at both 01:30s.

name: dst_spring
doc: Europe/London 2027-03-28 01:00 GMT -> 02:00 BST: time triggers at local wall times; motion either side of the gap.

name: jump_forward_over_trigger
doc: Wall clock jumps +2 h at 22:59: 23:00 and 23:30 timers (loop time) fire late, at 01:00 and 01:30 wall.

name: jump_back_after_trigger
doc: Wall clock jumps -1 h at 23:10 after 23:00 fired: no second 23:00 tonight; 23:30 timer fires early by loop time, re-arms, fires at 23:30 wall.

name: jump_back_over_trigger
doc: Wall clock jumps -1 h at 23:00:30 (just after the 23:00 fire): 23:00 is not repeated when the wall clock passes it again.

name: startup_restore
doc: Restore: last_triggered comes back; a restored 'off' stays off (no triggers attach); 'current' is not restored (0).

name: startup_integration_late
doc: Hue not ready at start: the registry placeholders (unavailable, restored) are written at homeassistant_start, so triggers attach to 'unavailable'; when hue delivers motion=on and lux=20 later, both triggers fire (from unavailable).

name: startup_missed_time
doc: HA boots at 23:05: the 23:00 trigger is not run retroactively.

name: service_turn_off_on
doc: automation.turn_off stops the running wait (stop_actions default) and detaches triggers; turn_on re-attaches (no fire for current on).
